faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Assistant post at PAU?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Project Assistant position at Punjab Agricultural University is 27 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Sc. degree in relevant fields or a Master's degree in Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, or Plant Breeding, along with experience in a Molecular Biology Laboratory. Punjabi language proficiency up to Matric level is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Project Assistant post is between 18 years and 45 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, which can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. How much is the application fee for the Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for all categories is Rs. 200/-. This fee needs to be paid online as part of the application process.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 27,000/- per month, along with 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant position at PAU primarily involves an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience for the interview round.

faq.question: Q7. In which mode should I apply for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates are required to download the application form, fill it, and submit it along with the necessary documents to the specified address.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and the application form are available on the official website of Punjab Agricultural University, www.pau.edu. You can download them from the website.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit self-attested copies of their educational certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, proof of age, and any other relevant documents as mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is based in Ludhiana, Punjab, at Punjab Agricultural University.
